config.method: two-phase curriculum: train on most-confident half first, then continue on full data at lower learning rate

summary: A two-phase curriculum that first trains exclusively on the most confidently weak-labeled half of the data, then continues from the same checkpoint onto the full dataset at a reduced learning rate to preserve early structure while generalizing to noisier examples, this approach achieved a PGR of 0.68 on the chat preference testbed.
source: Wen, Qiu, et al., 'Automated Weak-to-Strong Researcher', Anthropic Alignment Science Blog, 2026
